body.text: Receipt codex-20260824T004823-02374715 reports 'python3 tools/transitional_root_absorption.py --verify: passed' and 'python3 -m pytest tests/test_transitional_root_absorption.py -q: passed: 13 tests' for commit 602c78cb. Both now fail. Counterexample, isolated from any local edit: 'git worktree add --detach <tmp> HEAD' followed by 'python3 tools/transitional_root_absorption.py --verify' in that clean worktree exits 1 with 'ledger drifted from measurement: generated/projections/estate/transitional-root-absorption.json'. The set difference is exactly one element, stored-only: components/BonfyreProject/bonfyre-project under deleted_pending_commit. 'git log -- components/BonfyreProject/bonfyre-project' is empty, so that path has never been tracked and no measurement of any tree can classify it as pending a commit. The ledger encodes a transient pre-commit git state and was committed in the same tranche that invalidated it. Suggested repair: make the measurement independent of pending-commit state, or regenerate and recommit the ledger after the deletion lands. Independently confirmed non-cause: this epoch rebuilt that binary via 'make -C components/BonfyreProject' and then removed it again; the drift is identical with the binary absent.

subject: transitional-root absorption ledger drift reproduces on a pristine HEAD worktree
